subject: Update plots to keep up with ggplot2

messages.author: ab076a7b9dcd86cb
messages.subject: Update plots to keep up with ggplot2
parts:
It looks like several of the plotting templates are not using the current geoms for ggplot.  Most particularly, the histogram appears broken unless you include binwidth.  I've run into a couple other instances where warnings are thrown about deprecated functionality, but don't recall them right now.
